headline:
Promoting personal growth
through higher education.
intro: Supporting the next chapter in education for Fox Chapel Golf Club employees, children of employees, and caddies.
closedNotice: The 2027 scholarship application deadline has passed. Thank you to everyone who applied.
welcome: Through the generosity of Club members, the Foundation helps eligible team members pursue post-secondary education. Scholarships are awarded for one year, and eligible applicants may reapply in later years.
eligibility: Club employees must have commenced employment before January 1, 2027 and have completed a minimum of 160 hours of work since their start date.
Caddies must have completed a minimum of 15 rounds (preferably 20) during 2026 and trending toward completing at least 15 rounds (preferably 20) in 2027.
Applicants must be enrolled at a qualified school for the Fall 2027 semester.
requirements: A recommendation letter from someone outside Fox Chapel Golf Club. Letters from FCGC personnel do not qualify.
A personal essay of 1–2 pages about your educational and career goals, how this scholarship would help, and significant experiences that have shaped your aspirations.
The first two pages of your FAFSA summary, if submitted.
Your school’s financial aid estimate for one full academic year.
A digital photo of the applicant (uploaded directly with the online application).
